description: Fetch one architecture diagram ArcSync parsed from infrastructure-as-code. `format: "mermaid"` (default) returns a Mermaid flowchart to show or embed; `format: "json"` returns the resources and relationships as lists to reason over. Both include a link to the interactive canvas. Prefer this to inferring architecture from source files.

graphId.description: The diagram's graphId, as list_diagrams or get_diagram returns it. The id start_parse returned also works.

name: get_diagram
title: Get an ArcSync diagram
